questions.title: How do I get the output of a shell command executed using into a variable from Jenkinsfile (groovy)?
questions.body: I want to search for a pattern in a file and count the number of occurrences. How can I store the output of grep -c pattern file into a variable in bash?

accepted_answer.body:
You can use command substitution:

count=$(grep -c pattern file)
echo "Found $count matches"

This captures the output of the command into the variable.

questions.title: How to find all files containing specific text on Linux
questions.body: I'm trying to find a way to scan my entire Linux system for all files containing a specific string of text. I want to find all files that contain a specific word or phrase.

accepted_answer.body:
Use grep with the recursive flag:

grep -rn "search_term" /path/to/search/

Options:

  • -r recursive
  • -n show line numbers
  • -l show only filenames
